maddeler.e:
ننخرط (form VII)
# نَنْخَرِطُ (nanḵariṭu) /nan.xa.ri.tˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْخَرَطَ (inḵaraṭa)
# نَنْخَرِطَ (nanḵariṭa) /nan.xa.ri.tˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْخَرَطَ (inḵaraṭa)
# نَنْخَرِطْ (nanḵariṭ) /nan.xa.ritˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْخَرَطَ (inḵaraṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
